bianchiByGlass.name: Pinot Grigio IGT 'Veneto'
bianchiByGlass.description: 100% Pinot Grigio, Crispy, fresh and fruity. Very elegant, soft and delicate. Full, aromatic.

bianchiByGlass.name: Chardonnay House Selection
bianchiByGlass.description: 100% Chardonnay. Bright aromas of pear, apple, a hint of tropical fruit with vanilla oak.

bianchiByGlass.name: Grillo IGT 'Sicily'
bianchiByGlass.description: 100% Grillo. Dry, fruity and subtle with an elegant refreshing bouquet and crisp acidity.

bianchiByGlass.name: Rosé House Selection
bianchiByGlass.description: 50% Cinsault 50% Grenache. Elegant, pear and peach flavors with balanced acidity.

bianchiByGlass.name: Sauvignon Blanc House Selection
bianchiByGlass.description: 100% Sauvignon Blanc. Peach, passionfruit and pear appear over a creamy, lemony finish.

bianchiByGlass.name: Falanghina House Selection
bianchiByGlass.description: 100% Falanghina. A complex wine, exotic fruit and soft spices note, good acidity and mineral note.

bianchiByGlass.name: Pecorino 'Abruzzo'
bianchiByGlass.description: 100% Pecorino. A complex wine, exotic fruit and soft spices note, good acidity and mineral note.

bianchiByGlass.name: Trebbiano House Selection
bianchiByGlass.description: 100% Zibibbo. Fruit scents of peach and mandarin to sage, floral notes of roses and wisteria.

bubblesAndDesserts.name: Prosecco DOCG
bubblesAndDesserts.description: 100% Glera. Scents of white flowers and golden apple. Good intensity, fresh, elegant and soft.

bubblesAndDesserts.name: Moscato
bubblesAndDesserts.description: 100% Moscato. Delicate notes of grapes, orange blossoms, elderflower; sweet fruit flavors.

rossiByGlass.name: Pinot Noir House Selection
rossiByGlass.description: 100% Pinot Noir. Aromas of violets, iris, raspberries, dark cherries, rose, blueberries, and wet stones.

rossiByGlass.name: Merlot IGT 'Veneto'
rossiByGlass.description: 100% Merlot. Bright and cheerful; black cherry and juicy raspberries, laced with hints of spice.

rossiByGlass.name: Montepulciano D'Abruzzo DOC 'Abruzzo'
rossiByGlass.description: 100% Montepulciano D'Abruzzo. Aromas and flavors of black plum, black cherry, and black olives.

rossiByGlass.name: Chianti DOCG 'Toscana'
rossiByGlass.description: 80% Sangiovese, 20% Merlot. Juicy with an intense harmonious taste. A great balance.

rossiByGlass.name: Sangiovese House Selection
rossiByGlass.description: 100% Sangiovese. Spicy red cherry and raspberry aromas and flavors.

rossiByGlass.name: Cabernet Sauvignon House Selection
rossiByGlass.description: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. Flavors of spicy black pepper, ripe blueberries, and black plum.

toscana.name: Chianti Classico
toscana.description: 100% Sangiovese. Bursting with raspberry, juniper berries, and well structured. (Organic)

toscana.name: Chianti Classico Riserva Valvirginio DOCG
toscana.description: 100% Sangiovese. Aromas of darks and red fruits with intense scents of spices. Well balanced.

toscana.name: Nobile di Montepulciano II Conventino Riserva DOCG
toscana.description: 85% Sangiovese, 15% Colorino. Withered flowers, berries, red ripe fruit with balsamic notes.

toscana.name: Brunello di Montalcino Collemattoni
toscana.description: 100% Sangiovese. Cherry, strawberry, eucalyptus, tobacco, and mineral flavors. Long finish.

toscana.name: Tignanello Antinori 2020
toscana.description: 80% Sangiovese, 15% Cabernet, 5% Cabernet Franc. Aromatic intensity and flavor of red fruit, sour cherry, spices, tobacco, and herbs

piemonte.name: Nebbiolo Terzetto DOC
piemonte.description: 100% Nebbiolo. Offers orange peel, raspberry, rose, cherry, and baking spice aromatics.

piemonte.name: Barbaresco Casetta DOCG
piemonte.description: 100% Nebbiolo. Intense with violet and blackberry hints. Full flower in the mouth

piemonte.name: Barolo Terzetto DOC
piemonte.description: 100% Nebbiolo. Intense bouquet of flowers and dark red fruit overtones. Slightly spicy.

veneto.name: Ripasso Scuola Grande DOCG
veneto.description: 40% Corvina, 30% Molinara, 30% Rondinella. Persistent notes of ripe red fruits, tobacco, spices and vanilla.

veneto.name: Amarone Scuola Grande DOCG
veneto.description: 40% Corvina, 35% Rondinella, 25% Molinara. Baked fruits, plums, and cherry with hints of coffee and cocoa

altreRegioni.name: Nero D'Avola Fina 'Sicilia'
altreRegioni.description: 100% Nero D'Avola. Intense and fruity flavors, nice inklings of eastern spice. Soft to the palate.

altreRegioni.name: Aglianico del Vulture Casa Maschito 'Basilicate'
altreRegioni.description: 100% Aglianico. Spicy red cherry and raspberry aroma and flavors. Pleasantly persistent.

altreRegioni.name: Primitivo Petraio 'Puglia'
altreRegioni.description: 100% Primitivo. Black cherry and spice aromas. Dry, ripe black fruit flavors with balanced acidity.
